result.title: TrajRealm: A Large-Scale Point Tracking Dataset with Diverse Dynamics
result.summary: General-purpose point tracking requires large-scale training data with diverse dynamics, yet existing datasets struggle to combine rich dynamic content, accurate scene geometry, and sufficient scale. We introduce TrajRealm, the first public synthetic point-tracking dataset to reach the ten-million-frame scale, constructed from games and embodied simulations. TrajRealm uses the rich environments and motion systems of modern games to capture diverse targets, activities, and interactions across diverse worlds, while embodied simulations add robot manipulation and indoor navigation data. The dataset provides RGB observations, depth, camera parameters, and persistent 2D and 3D point trajectories. These annotations provide precise, geometrically consistent supervision across foreground objects and static environmental surfaces. We also build TrajRealm-Bench with eight subcategories under Interaction and Locomotion to evaluate tracking across diverse scenes. Benchmark evaluations reveal the strengths and limitations of existing trackers in handling complex motion and maintaining long-term point correspondences. Training on TrajRealm improves the performance of existing tracking methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: TrajRealm 构建了首个达到千万帧规模的公开合成点跟踪数据集，融合游戏与具身仿真环境，提供 RGB、深度、相机参数以及持续的 2D/3D 点轨迹，并配套含 Interaction 与 Locomotion 八个子类的基准来评测现有跟踪器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其长时点对应与几何一致的 3D 轨迹标注可能为 LVR 中跨帧保持视觉证据、维护持久视觉状态这类问题提供训练或评价线索，但能否与多模态推理状态耦合仍需核查。
